name: usage-quota
description: Know your Claude limits before they hit you (Live pane docked on the right of Claude Code): 5 Hour and Weekly usage (whole account) with a live usage forecast against limit resets, context window usage, one-click Compact and per-session Auto compact (30% default).

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: right: a pane docked beside the transcript (above the prompt in a narrow or non-fullscreen terminal); bottom: the band above the prompt

show_limits.title: Show plan limits
show_limits.description: The 5 Hour and Weekly limits, their forecast and the headline above them

show_context.title: Show context window
show_context.description: How full the context window is, and what fills it

show_compact_forecast.title: Show turns until compact
show_compact_forecast.description: About how many more replies until the context is compacted, from how fast it has grown

show_cache.title: Show cache countdown
show_cache.description: How long until the prompt cache expires

show_cache_hits.title: Show cache hit rate
show_cache_hits.description: How much of the last turn's input the prompt cache served

show_session.title: Show session cost
show_session.description: What this session has cost so far, and how many prompts it has had

show_last_turn.title: Show last turn
show_last_turn.description: How long the last turn took, its output tokens and its model

show_agents.title: Show running agents
show_agents.description: The subagents and teammates running, and the ones that ended lately; press one for its details

show_shells.title: Show background shells
show_shells.description: The background shells running, and the ones that ended lately; press one for its output
